title: Any ROS battery (sensor_msgs/BatteryState)
note: Vendor-neutral: binds the one topic of type sensor_msgs/BatteryState. ROS defines current as negative when discharging and percentage as 0-1. Machine class is not known from the message, so scenarios that require one do not apply until a private profile states it.

recording.time: log (receive) time, seconds from the first message of the recording
